findings.evidence: The approved case-study link is 'Read the AltContext case study'; the JSX adds a separate visible '.' after at line 42.
findings.impact: The entrance adds punctuation not present in the verbatim deck and renders a separated full stop after the link.
findings.recommendation: Remove the standalone period after the link, or approve and render the punctuation as part of one copy-deck string.
findings.rule: Sections 4 and 7.4 Entrance — verbatim copy parity

findings.evidence: fallbackLabel is 'Sample photo unavailable. ${altText}' at line 17, but the visible fallback is Sample photo unavailable immediately followed by {altText} at lines 27-28.
findings.impact: When the image fails, sighted users see the fallback words joined without the required period and space, unlike the exact aria-label.
findings.recommendation: Render fallbackLabel visibly, or add '. ' between the visible heading and description.

findings.evidence: The panel adds the visible paragraph 'How this works' before the approved three-item how-it-works list at lines 35-39; section 7.4 lists only the ordered-list sentences.
findings.impact: The face panel shows unapproved duplicate explanatory copy, so the rendered surface is not character-for-character aligned with the deck.
findings.recommendation: Remove the added heading/label, or add it explicitly to the approved deck and UX-map copy.
findings.rule: Section 7.4 Faces panel — how-it-works list and verbatim parity

findings.evidence: The reachable thumbnail-error label is 'Face image unavailable' at lines 111-125, while GuidedFaceMatchCard passes the approved position-specific alt 'Face on the {position}' at lines 46 and 50.
findings.impact: A failed face crop loses the left/right context used by the two-face story and introduces copy not covered by the face-card deck.
findings.recommendation: Preserve the passed position-specific label in the error state, with any unavailable-image wording approved in the deck.
findings.rule: Section 7.4 Face match card crop and edge-copy parity

findings.evidence: The review explanation says 'Confirm or skip each face match first', while the guide says 'keep that person unnamed' at GuidedPrototypeGuide.tsx:18 and the decision button says 'Keep this person unnamed' at GuidedFacesPanel.tsx:103.
findings.impact: A non-technical site owner may not know that 'skip' means the explicit Keep unnamed choice used elsewhere in the same flow.
findings.recommendation: Use the same identity-action verb in the explanation, preferably 'keep the person unnamed', and update the deck/map together.
findings.rule: Lens 4 Narrative coherence and plain-language consistency

findings.evidence: The Source column on rows 5-10 contains labels such as 'Wikimedia Commons File:Justin Trudeau Katy Perry 2.jpg'; an https URL is absent from all six rows.
findings.impact: Maintainers and reviewers cannot follow a source link to verify the bundled image attribution or licence.
findings.recommendation: Replace each file-title label with the exact Wikimedia/source URL for that bundled image.
findings.rule: Lens 8 Licensing and credits — source URL per bundled image

findings.evidence: Rows 5-10 have only File, Subject, Source, Author, and Licence columns; the only transformation note is the aggregate sentence 'Images were resized...' at line 12, with no per-image crop/resize value.
findings.impact: The credit record cannot tell which of the six files was cropped or resized, and it cannot support the required change indication for adapted CC BY-SA images.
findings.recommendation: Add a Changes column and record the actual cropped/resized operation for every row.
findings.rule: Lens 8 Licensing and credits — crop/resize status per bundled image

findings.evidence: Both Justin rows (`guided-justin-trudeau-2025.jpg` and `...2025-b.jpg`) list licence 'Attribution' at lines 9-10, while state.ts exposes only 'European Union, 2025' at lines 180 and 185; neither is one of CC BY, CC BY-SA 4.0, CC0, or public domain.
findings.impact: The two hidden gallery credits do not communicate an allowed licence, leaving the bundled Justin images legally incomplete and inconsistent with the allowed-license contract.
findings.recommendation: Verify the source licence for both Justin files and use the exact allowed licence string in CREDITS.md and state.ts, or remove files whose rights cannot be verified.
findings.rule: Lens 8 Licensing and credits — allowed licence and state/CREDITS parity

findings.evidence: The visible press credit is 'Colleen Sturtevant, CC BY-SA 4.0' at lines 139 and 329 of the page; the hidden 2019 gallery credit is 'Glenn Francis, CC BY-SA 4.0' at line 161. CREDITS.md identifies the press row and 2019 source as resized/cropped assets but supplies no change indication.
findings.impact: The press credit and hidden CC BY-SA gallery credit omit the required indication that the bundled works were changed.
findings.recommendation: Append the actual change indication to both rendered credit strings and mirror it in their CREDITS rows (for example, resized and cropped-and-resized where applicable).
findings.rule: Lens 8 Licensing and credits — CC BY-SA author, licence, and changes

findings.evidence: CREDITS.md says 'Glenn Francis (Toglenn)' for the 2019 file while state.ts says 'Glenn Francis, CC BY-SA 4.0' at line 161; it says 'Public domain' for 2016 while state.ts says 'public domain' at line 167.
findings.impact: The documentation and hidden gallery credit disagree on the author form and licence capitalization for two bundled images.
findings.recommendation: Choose one exact author/licence spelling for each image and use it in both CREDITS.md and state.ts.
findings.rule: Lens 8 Licensing and credits — exact CREDITS/state parity

findings.evidence: Undo is rendered only when appliedEvent exists at lines 217-221; state.ts:460-464 returns unchanged when no application is available, and GuidedPrototypePage.tsx:246-248 always supplies the feedback 'Apply undone.'.
findings.impact: The no-available-application edge has no plain-language user state, and any invocation of the handler in that state would announce an action that did not happen.
findings.recommendation: Add an approved no-op Undo message or disabled control and gate the 'Apply undone.' feedback on an actual available application.
findings.rule: Lens 10 Empty, error, and edge copy; section 7.3 undo no-op
